# homebot v0.1.0

homebot keeps a dotfiles repo in order across your machines. It links files,
seals secrets, runs an hourly helper, and puts work that needs you in a short
inbox. This first release is for macOS and Linux.

## Install

```sh
brew install --cask hyperlab-sh/tap/homebot
```

Or use the front door, which needs `bash`, installs this release after checking
its installer against the checksums, and takes `--persona` and `--name`:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://homebot.sh/install | bash
```

Or install the release binary without `sudo`, with the installer attached to
this release (it takes `--version`, and runs under `sh`):

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://github.com/hyperlab-sh/homebot/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

Debian and RPM packages, checksums, signatures and the installer script are
attached to this release. With Go 1.26 or newer, you can use
`go install github.com/hyperlab-sh/homebot/cmd/homebot@latest`.

## Verify a download

Check the downloaded file against `checksums.txt`, then verify the checksum
file's Sigstore bundle with cosign 2.4.3 through 2.x:

```sh
cosign verify-blob --new-bundle-format \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/hyperlab-sh/homebot/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v0.1.0 \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --bundle checksums.txt.sigstore.json checksums.txt
```

For cosign 3.x, omit `--new-bundle-format`. The
[install guide](https://homebot.sh/docs/install/) has the complete verification
and setup steps.

## Updates and limits

`homebot version --check` checks for a release when you ask. `update: off` is
the default. `notify` reports a newer release. `auto` waits
48 hours after first seeing it and can upgrade signed script installs and the
Homebrew cask; script installs require cosign 2.4.3 or newer on the helper's
PATH. Debian, RPM and `go install` users get a manual update command.

There is no Windows build. The macOS binary is not notarized in v0.1.0;
the Homebrew cask clears quarantine for its installed binary. Automatic
updates run only in the background helper after `homebot setup`.
